meta.description: Learn to spot scams, check messages, and get help fast. English and Kinyarwanda.

hero.title: Spot the scam before it costs you.
hero.body: Paste a message, link or phone number and see how risky it is, and why. If something already went wrong, get clear steps in minutes.

learn.title: Learn
learn.body: Short lessons, real scam stories and practice drills.

help.title: Get help
help.body: Tell the chatbot what happened and follow clear steps, most urgent first.

check.title: Check
check.body: Paste a message, link or number and see how risky it is, and why.

report.title: Report
report.body: Save proof, report the scam and follow what happens next.

steps.title: Ask or paste
steps.body: Tell us what happened, or paste the message.

steps.title: We check
steps.body: Clear rules and a pattern-spotting program look for scam signs.

steps.title: We explain
steps.body: You get a risk level and the reasons, not just yes or no.

steps.title: You act
steps.body: Follow the steps, save proof and report it.

rule.title: Never share your password, PIN or one-time code.
rule.body: Not with anyone. Not even a bank, and not even us. The chatbot warns you if you type one.
